payload.idea: A platform where students list second-hand textbooks for sale

payload.feedback:
The output provides a solid start—value proposition, three personas, a prioritized feature list, and three user stories—but it falls short of being fully specific, complete, and actionable for product development. Missing or weak elements include:
1. **Detailed Acceptance Criteria** – Each user story needs clear "given/when/then" acceptance tests to guide design, development, and QA.
2. **Comprehensive Feature Scope** – The feature list stops at moderation; critical capabilities such as payment gateway integration details, escrow handling, notification system, reporting/analytics, mobile app considerations, and API endpoints are omitted.
3. **Non‑Functional Requirements** – No mention of performance (search latency), security (data encryption, GDPR/FERPA compliance), scalability, availability, or accessibility standards.
4. **Technical Architecture & Tech Stack** – No guidance on platform (web vs. native mobile), backend services, database schema, third‑party services (e.g., Stripe, university SSO), or hosting requirements.
5. **Roadmap & Milestones** – No timeline, MVP definition, or phased rollout plan (e.g., pilot at one campus, then expand).
6. **Metrics & Success Criteria** – No KPIs (e.g., number of listings per month, transaction volume, user satisfaction scores) to measure product success.
7. **Risk & Mitigation** – No identification of potential risks (scams, fraud, legal issues) or mitigation strategies beyond a generic admin moderation feature.
8. **Compliance & Legal** – No discussion of university policy alignment, copyright considerations for textbook listings, or payment compliance.
9. **User Experience Details** – Missing wireframe concepts, flow diagrams, or UI mock‑up guidance for the listing wizard, search UI, and escrow workflow.
10. **Stakeholder & Operational Considerations** – No mention of support processes, customer service, or how the campus housing coordinator persona would interact with the system beyond “moderation”.

To make the output actionable, expand each of these areas, provide concrete acceptance criteria for the user stories, outline a technical stack and architecture diagram, define an MVP scope with a release schedule, and list measurable success metrics. Only then can the team move forward confidently.

features.name: User Registration & Student Verification
features.description: OAuth integration with university SSO (Shibboleth/SAML); automatic enrollment check via registrar API; multi‑factor email/phone verification; profile dashboard; GDPR‑compliant data handling.

features.name: Listing Creation & Management Wizard
features.description: Step‑by‑step form capturing title, author, ISBN (auto‑filled via Google Books API), edition, condition scale (1‑5), price, course code tags, and up to 6 photos with auto‑compression; draft/save, edit, deactivate, and bulk‑import CSV for power users; preview mode.

features.name: Search, Filter & Recommendation Engine
features.description: Full‑text search on title/ISBN, facet filters (course, price range, condition, distance), relevance ranking, saved searches, and AI‑driven “similar listings” suggestions; sub‑second latency via Elasticsearch cluster; mobile‑responsive UI.

features.name: Messaging, Payment Integration & Escrow Workflow
features.description: In‑app chat with read receipts; Stripe Connect integration for credit/debit cards and ACH; escrow holds buyer payment (10 % platform commission) until seller marks as shipped; automated release on buyer confirmation or after 3‑day auto‑release; email/SMS notifications; transaction logs for audit.

features.name: Ratings, Reviews, Moderation & Analytics Dashboard
features.description: Post‑transaction star rating and free‑text review for buyer and seller; flagging system with automated spam detection; admin console for approving/rejecting listings, handling disputes, and viewing KPIs (listings per day, GMV, churn); GDPR data‑deletion tools; accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA).

user_stories.i_want: to register using my university SSO and prove my enrollment, Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN the user lands on the signup page, WHEN they click "Sign in with University" and complete MFA, THEN an account is created, the student status flag is set, and the user is redirected to the dashboard; AND if the enrollment API returns false, THEN show a friendly error and block marketplace access.
user_stories.so_that: I can safely buy or sell textbooks knowing only other students can participate.

user_stories.i_want: to create a textbook listing with all required details and photos, Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN I am logged in, WHEN I open the "New Listing" wizard, THEN I must fill title, author, ISBN (auto‑filled), edition, condition (1‑5), price, and at least one photo; WHEN I click "Preview", THEN I see a read‑only view; WHEN I submit, THEN the listing becomes searchable immediately and I receive a confirmation email; AND validation prevents empty or out‑of‑range fields.
user_stories.so_that: Buyers can find accurate, trustworthy listings and I can sell my book quickly.

user_stories.i_want: to purchase a textbook through an escrow‑protected payment flow, Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN I have found a listing, WHEN I click "Buy Now" and confirm price, THEN the system creates a Stripe payment intent, holds the funds, and notifies the seller; WHEN the seller marks the order as shipped, THEN I receive a shipping notification with tracking; WHEN I confirm receipt, THEN funds (minus commission) are released to the seller; IF I do not confirm within 3 days, THEN the system auto‑releases; AND at any point I can open a dispute which flags the transaction for admin review.
user_stories.so_that: Both the buyer and seller are protected from fraud and have a clear, automated transaction path.

  • Admin moderation and dispute handling
  • Student‑to‑admin communication and policy compliance
  • Seller order fulfillment (shipping label generation, return handling)
  • Mobile‑first experience (native app or PWA specifics)
  • Accessibility testing and localization

- **Missing Product Metrics & Success Criteria**: No definition of MVP scope, launch timeline, key performance indicators (GMV targets, user acquisition, churn), or A/B testing plan.
- **Monetisation & Business Model**: No pricing model for the 10 % commission, optional premium listings, or university partnership revenue sharing.
- **Design Artifacts**: No wireframes, UI mock‑ups, or design system guidelines, which are needed before engineering can estimate effort.
- **Legal & Policy Details**: No terms of service, privacy policy outline, or university policy alignment checklist.
To be actionable, the deliverable should include these missing elements, a prioritized roadmap, and clearer, uniformly formatted user stories with complete acceptance criteria.
